g.text: Motor prior sensitivity in one real glioma case

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f40

g.text: UCSF-PDGM-0004 · Same fixed axis, alternative generic aspiration tools

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f40

g.text: A: motor map support ≥ 0.5 in any contacted native cell; whiskers are conditional 95% Wilson intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f40

g.text: Intervals describe finite Monte Carlo error only. B–C use continuous map support; contact is not tissue removal.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f40

g.text: Per-axis Gaussian translation / rotation SD; 64 worlds per setting. Worst 5% = empirical CVaR₉₅ with a fractional tail.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172f40

g.text: Unreviewed population prior · Uncalibrated sensitivity · One consulted patient · No clinical injury probabilities
